identity.title: Planck's dusty GEMS. IV. Star formation and feedback in a maximum starburst at z = 3 seen at 60-pc resolution

paper_type_evidence.quote: Here we report on ALMA 0.1$''$ resolution observations from the first long-baseline observing cycle of ALMA of the strongly lensed $z=3$ galaxy PLCK G244.8$+$54.9, the “Ruby”.

question.value: How intense can star formation be in a maximal starburst at z=3, and is it self-regulated by feedback (radiation pressure, supernovae and winds) as seen on ~60 pc scales?

evidence.quote: We also present a first discussion of how feedback from star formation leaves its imprint on the resolved star-formation law and kinematic properties of the gas.
